message: COPY INQCOM (line 16, under 01 WS-COMMAREA), COPY ERRHND (line 25, under 01 WS-ERROR-AREA) and COPY INQCOM (line 37, under 01 DFHCOMMAREA) each insert a level-01 record (INQCOM-AREA, ERROR-HANDLING) directly below a program 01 with no subordinate items of its own. As written, the copybook 01 begins a new record and the enclosing 01 has no subordinate entries. Registered as EXPANDS_COPY from the enclosing program record (best-effort parent assignment, as Agent 2 records the stub under the 01); the holder records' total_bytes (98, 174, 98) are the expanded copybook sizes and inline_bytes is 0.

Copybook INQCOM is expanded twice (WORKING-STORAGE line 16 and LINKAGE line 37) with no REPLACING, so record INQCOM-AREA and its field names are declared in both sections. Both expansions point to the single copybook record SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0020-REC-0001.
